title: totalWithDiscount ignores quantity and misreads percent
prompt: totalWithDiscount in src/pricing.ts gives wrong totals: it ignores each item's quantity and treats the percentage (0-100) as a fraction. Fix it. The result is in cents, rounded to the nearest cent. A discount below 0 or above 100 must throw a RangeError. Keep the file valid for Node's type stripping (no enums or parameter properties).
